description: Run the ABAP Unit tests in the transpiled backend — the local test classes deployed with an app (deploy_app `testclasses`, built by build_backend) — and get ASSERTIONS instead of a picture: which test methods ran, which the framework skips, and the first failure with its error. With `class_name` only that object's test classes run (the generated runner is filtered on it); without it every deployed app's tests run on the npm backend, and on a framework checkout every test of the transpiled tree, the framework's own included, which takes minutes. A test that passes here passes on the system too, short of what the open-abap runtime cannot model (see pitfalls, area abap). A run too long to list in one answer counts its tests per object (`testsPerObject`, the skipped ones still listed) instead of naming each - class_name narrows it. Needs a build_backend after the deploy that carried the tests.

class_name.description: the app class whose test classes to run, e.g. zcl_my_app; leave it out (or null) for every deployed app's tests - on a framework checkout the whole tree, minutes. An empty string is refused, not read as "all"

class_names.description: several classes in one run (the deployed apps of a project, say); null is the same as leaving it out, an empty list is refused

name: run_unit_tests
